statement:
∀ n : ℕ, 4000000000000000000<n → (n:ℝ)<Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) →
let z := ⌈(n:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/5)⌉₊
let y := max ⌈(n:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)⌉₊ ⌈Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)/(z:ℝ))⌉₊
let A := (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬p∣n ∧
  ((Finset.Ico 2 z).filter (fun q => q.Prime ∧ q∣n-p))=∅)
let B := A.filter (fun p => 2≤n-p)
let P := (Finset.Ico z y).filter Nat.Prime
let W (s : ℕ) : ℤ := 2-((P.filter (fun q => q∣s)).card:ℤ)-
  ((P.filter (fun q => q^2∣s)).card:ℤ)
2<z ∧ z<y ∧ n≤y^3 ∧ n≤z*y^2 ∧
(∑ q∈P, ((B.filter (fun p => q^2∣n-p)).card:ℝ)) < (n:ℝ)/(100*(Real.log n)^2) ∧
((n:ℝ)/(100*(Real.log n)^2) ≤ 2*(B.card:ℝ)-
  (∑ q∈P, ((B.filter (fun p => q∣n-p)).card:ℝ)) →
  0<(∑ p∈B,W (n-p)))

plain_statement.zh: 把原加权筛中素数平方整除的损失压到百分之一
plain_statement.en: Bound repeated prime-square divisibility by one hundredth of the normalized sieve budget

brief.zh: 沿用 F09 的五次根 z 和 y 以及原筛集。若 q² 整除余项 n−p，正整数 m=(n−p)/q² 与 30030 互素。用模 30030 的 5760 个单位剩余类作单射计数，再求和；同一个余项上的不同素数平方分别计费。给出原带符号整数和为正的充分条件。
brief.en: Use the F09 fifth-root parameters and the original sifted summands. For each square divisor q² of n−p, the positive cofactor is coprime to 30030. Counting quotient blocks and the 5760 unit residues bounds every square incidence. Sum over q with multiplicity and apply the verified signed-sieve identity.
